title: 恐龙有多大
subtitle: 从一只鸡到三辆公交车
character: wearing a moss green t-shirt, navy shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, soft gouache painting with visible brush strokes, warm earth tones, sage green and bone white, gentle rounded shapes

pages.zh:
博物馆里挂着一根骨头，
比我整个人还长。
爸爸说，
这只是恐龙的
一小截腿。
pages.scene: Waist-up view of the little boy indoors, his face large in the frame and turned towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, his mouth open in surprise. Beside him rises one huge dinosaur leg bone far taller than he is. A plain pale wall behind.

pages.zh:
最大的恐龙
有多长呢？
把三辆公交车
首尾接起来，
差不多就那么长。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one long dinosaur silhouette on a cream background with three bus shapes lined up end to end beneath it, the two rows exactly the same length. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
最小的恐龙
只有一只鸡那么大。
它在草丛里
跑来跑去捉虫子。
它也是恐龙。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one small dinosaur silhouette and one chicken silhouette standing side by side on a cream background, exactly the same height. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
大恐龙走过去，
地上踩出一个坑。
下过雨以后，
坑里积了水，
小动物就来喝。
pages.scene: One large round footprint hollow in the ground on a cream background with a little water in it and one small lizard drinking at its edge. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它有多重呢？
一头大象已经很重了，
最大的恐龙，
要十头大象
加起来才够。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one elephant shape alone on the left of a cream background, and ten of the same elephant shape arranged in two rows on the right. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
长这么大
是要有本事的。
它的脖子很长，
站着不动，
就能吃到好远的叶子。
pages.scene: One long-necked dinosaur standing beside a tall tree on a cream background, its head reaching the leaves at the very top. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它的骨头
也和我们的不一样。
里面有很多空洞，
像面包一样，
又结实又轻。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one bone cut open lengthwise on a cream background showing many round hollow holes inside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
大也有大的麻烦。
身体越大，
要吃的就越多。
它一天到晚，
几乎都在吃东西。
pages.scene: One big long-necked dinosaur eating from a huge pile of leaves on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
一天要吃多少呢？
差不多能堆成
一座小山，
比一辆汽车
还要高。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one tall heap of leaves on a cream background with one car shape standing beside it, the heap clearly taller than the car. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
小恐龙也有小的好处。
吃得少，
跑得快，
听见动静，
一下就钻进草里。
pages.scene: One small dinosaur running into tall grass on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
从最小的
排到最大的，
中间隔着好多种。
它们都叫恐龙，
个子却差得那么远。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: five dinosaur silhouettes standing in a row on a cream background, each one taller than the one before it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我站在骨架下面，
抬起头看。
它的一根脚趾，
就比我的手
还要大。
pages.scene: Waist-up view of the little boy standing under a huge mounted dinosaur skeleton, his chin lifted as he looks up but his face turned towards the viewer and large in the frame, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight. One enormous toe bone stands beside him at his shoulder height.
